description: Election Commission - T. W. R. Bandara was selected as the member of the Beliatta Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Beliatta Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local government, including the resignation of a member and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new member by the returning officer. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it pertains to electoral processes and declarations at the local government level.
